newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sterling well supported at 2.780-area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sterling well supported at 2.780-area.

text.p: Sterling is running out of momentum against the mark but the currency will remain well supported at the 2.780- mark area after its sprint on Thursday to fresh 4-1/2 year highs at above 2.79 marks, said analysts.
"Sterling/mark looks overbought, it has for some time...But it should continue to be supported by a strong dollar/mark," said Alan Dunne, technical analyst at Bank America.

At 0750 GMT sterling was trading at 2.7894/05 marks vs 2.7891/02 in late Europe on Thursday. While stg/mark on Thursday powered to fresh 4-1/2 year highs of 2.7985 marks, analysts said it is running out of steam.
